content_sections.heading: Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Vacancy 2026 - Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: 125 AWT vacancies are spread across 7 ICDS Projects in Rangareddy district: A detailed Anganwadi Worker Training Centre (AWC)-wise vacancy list with individual centre names and category reservation is also available in the official annexure. Based on that annexure, the category-wise break-up of the 125 posts computed by this office is: Note: this category break-up is derived by counting entries in the AWC-wise annexure and is not a figure directly stated in the notification text - it should be cross-checked against the official list before publication.

content_sections.heading: Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification states that applications are invited only from women candidates who are residents within the limits of the respective ICDS project where the vacancy exists. Candidate-specific eligibility beyond this is directed to the official website for full details.

content_sections.heading: Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (Class 12) as the minimum qualification. For the Anganwadi Helper/Aya post, if Intermediate-qualified candidates are not available for a particular post, candidates who have passed 10th class (SSC) will be considered eligible, as per the notification.

content_sections.heading: Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: wdcw.tg.nic.in Check the detailed eligibility criteria and vacancy list for the relevant ICDS project. Apply online only - no offline applications will be accepted. Submit the application between 31-08-2026 and 10-09-2026, before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is Rangareddy Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by WCDW Rangareddy to fill 125 Anganwadi Teacher posts across 7 ICDS projects in Rangareddy district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: 125 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies across Amangal, Chevella, Hayathnagar, Ibrahimpatnam, Maheshwaram, Serilingampally, and Shadnagar projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 10 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM, online only.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Through the official website wdcw.tg.nic.in, within the application window of 31-08-2026 to 10-09-2026.

faq.answer: Only women candidates who are residents within the limits of the respective ICDS project where the vacancy exists.
